resources.string: Enter an HTTP or HTTPS address to browse. Search sources and an app account are not required.
Browse and save compatible HTTPS MP4 files for free. HLS, advanced recording and editing use their existing access checks.
Ordinary tabs share system WebView cookies. Clearing them signs out websites. Saved page addresses remain unchanged.
Only files you select in the system picker are shared with this page. No camera, microphone or folder access is granted. Navigation cancels the request.
Disabling this may affect video and sign-in pages. No native bridge is injected.
Off by default. Ordinary tabs share cookies; this does not promise incognito or per-tab isolation.
Only addresses are saved. Turning this off removes saved tab addresses, without clearing cookies. Restored pages require you to open them manually.
Up to 12 tabs. Older pages are released beyond the active-page limit; returning restores bounded in-memory history.
Camera, microphone and location requests are explicitly denied. File upload requires confirmation and file selection each time.
View source configuration and maintenance in Sources. Real payment is unavailable. Free browsing does not depend on sources or entitlements.
Applying this search; waiting for operation confirmation.
Demo data: locally synthesized, not real search results. Taps only exercise page navigation.
Source configuration changed. Previous results and page cursors are invalid. Check sources and filters, then search explicitly.
Local sorting keeps this page and applies to subsequent pages
Applied query and filters cannot currently be checked. Saved values have not been replaced with defaults.
No selectable sources in the registry. Saved source filters are preserved.
Source filters limit result namespaces. They do not enable sources or change the query. An empty selection means all currently enabled sources.
Discard draft and restore applied query and filters
Direct download is free. HLS and recording require their existing feature access.
Network limits: compatible HTTPS MP4 or bounded static HLS; 2 GiB per file, 4 GiB transfer budget per task; 2 hours per manual attempt, 60 seconds for verification, up to 100 unfinished tasks.
Switching or closing tabs does not cancel started tasks. Network saving pauses in the background and requires manual continuation. After restart, unfinished sources must be reselected.
Recording uses separate system consent each time. It does not end with a network-download pause. Navigation may change captured content. Download failure never starts recording automatically.

HLS supports only unencrypted static TS VOD, fixed quality, continuous AVC Baseline and optional AAC-LC. Live, DASH, split tracks, fMP4, transcoding and format changes are unsupported. Cached fragments are not a completed video; output needs independent MP4 verification.
HLS limits: 10,000 fragments, 128 MiB each; 2 MiB per manifest, 8 MiB total; reserve 2 GiB for output before downloading.
Save storage is not ready. Browsing remains available.
No save tasks yet. Return to a page to select media, or explicitly open recording.
Task history remains here. Rename, move or delete output in Library. Deleted output cannot be regenerated from this record.
Candidates may be advertisements or other clips. Check before selecting. Page-declared quality and duration are still verified locally before saving.

Compatible MP4 download is free; HLS requires streaming access. Select a fixed quality after manifest inspection. Short-lived cookies go only to the original same-origin resource, never redirected or child resources.
Only unencrypted static TS VOD, AVC Baseline and optional AAC-LC are supported. Declared quality still needs media verification. No automatic quality switching or transcoding.
Inspecting the manifest within budget; no save task has been created yet…
The ordinary library is free and lists only verified, published videos.
Thumbnails are generated on demand for the visible foreground page. Unreadable items retain an explicit placeholder.
Media resources have not confirmed release. Thumbnails are unavailable. Fully close and reopen the app.
Waiting for the previous preview to release media resources before generating thumbnails…
Choose a destination folder, then confirm the move. Only the location inside the ordinary library changes.
Processing operation; completion is not confirmed yet…
Library is not ready. Refresh to retry.
Export and local saving are separate operations. Nothing is automatically published, shared or moved into Vault.
This is the time legacy data was imported into Library, not its capture or original save time.
Ordinary media storage is not encrypted Vault storage. Preview is local and read-only; playback starts manually.
Export is not ready. The original remains unchanged; return and retry later.
A folder containing items cannot be deleted directly. Move items individually first. No silent recursive deletion occurs.
Names allow at most 255 UTF-8 bytes and no path separators or control characters. Sibling names use NFC and locale-independent case comparison.
This removes the video and its local original from Library. There is no recycle bin or in-app recovery. Separately exported copies remain unchanged. Save-task history is retained.
File cleanup waits for active media readers to release. Pending cleanup remains explicitly visible.
Only this empty folder is deleted. Changed content or revision rejects the operation. Contents are never recursively deleted.
